name: Eternal Guardian Endurance (Combat)
body:
You feed on the energy of fallen foes to renew your combat abilities.

Prerequisites: Eternal Guardian Style, Eternal Guardian Oath, Intimidate 11 ranks.

Benefit: Once per round, when you reduce a cursed opponent to 0 or fewer hit points, you can recover an expended maneuver as a free action.
